description: Election Commission - H. M. Don Alfred Lionel Jayasinghe was selected as the member of the Galnewa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Galnewa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member who ceased to belong to their political party, including the nomination by the party secretary and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
